title: TRANSPORTATION COMMITTEE REPORT relative to converting Class 4 bikeways from plastic bollard to rigid delineators.
text:
[Council File 26-0600-S105]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
TRANSPORTATION COMMITTEE REPORT relative to converting Class 4 bikeways from plastic bollard to rigid delineators.
Recommendations for Council action:
NOTE and FILE the June 24, 2026 Adopted Budget Recommendation.
INSTRUCT the Los Angeles Department of Transportation to report to the Transportation Committee on the cost to convert Class 4 bikeways from plastic bollard to concrete or other rigid delineators.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
Yes
For: North Westwood Neighborhood Council
summary: A budget recommendation to replace plastic bollards with rigid delineators on Class 4 (protected) bikeways.
